name: Dealing With Death Of Parent
overview: Scripture offers comfort and hope for those grieving the death of a parent by emphasizing God's nearness and care for the brokenhearted. The Lord, portrayed as a shepherd, provides guidance and protection even through the 'valley of the shadow of death,' assuring believers they need not fear evil. God strengthens and upholds His people, healing their wounds and drawing near to those with contrite spirits. Additionally, Isaiah reminds us that the righteous are taken away from evil, highlighting God's sovereign purpose even in loss.
